Love the fact that the grease drippings are drained away thus preventing fires under the food. Apparently I missed reading  the fact that the first position of the gas adjusting knob is the maximum heat position, so, initially I thought that the grill wasn't putting out enough heat. I had it set at its lowest level. My old grill settings were the opposite of this one.
This grill makes the grilling so much easier.

Results.ReviewText: I've had it for two months now. We grill at least 3 times a week, even in winter. It's the perfect size with two burners (there are only two of us here). It's attractive to look at. It's sturdily made. The wheels roll very smooth - which is great (even necessary for me as I'm no spring chicken) because we tuck it away in a corner of the deck after every use. It's easier to clean than any grill I've had before. It remains to be seen as to how it holds up in this Pacific Northwest climate, but has lived up to the other promises so I'm very hopeful. We LOVE it. If there is any complaint I would say it was more time consuming to put together than expected and it's hard to lift a full tank of gas into the cabinet and on to the weighing mechanism. Still doesn't stop me from saying I LOVE it.

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
